title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

reports.title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

summary:
Peter Solomon Ruma, 37, of Vero Beach was arrested and held on a $1 million bond. Police say he used photos from social media and other online sources to create and share AI-generated sexually explicit images of women without consent. Investigators searched his home and devices Wednesday and found evidence. He faces eight charges involving one female victim from June to August 2026, including three counts of creating altered sexual depictions, three counts of promoting them, one count of sexual cyber harassment, and one count of stalking.

Police have identified several additional potential victims who may not know images were made or shared, and they believe Ruma may have done this for years. He has a prior criminal history, including a 2007 arrest for burglary and sex battery on a physically impaired person. The investigation is ongoing and more charges could be filed. Anyone who thinks they were victimized or has information is urged to contact Vero Beach Police.
